name: depthwatch
description: Depthwatch: an open-source liquidity observatory for Base mainnet. Depth at ±1/2/5%, effective spread, LP concentration, liquidity persistence and a Liquidity Health Score for Uniswap v3/v4, Aerodrome and Aero pools on Base: every pool of those factories with log discovery, or the pools between the reference tokens with discover --seed.

scripts.build:static: tsx apps/cli/src/main.ts export --demo --out apps/web/static-data/bundle.json && pnpm --filter @depthwatch/web build:static
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.check:all: pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm build:static
